{{Quote|Greetings, fellow spiritual traveler! Have you come to lead me home? Good. The Shrub is generous and giving to all.|A servant of the Shrub|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''The Shrub''' was a type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] worshiped as a religious entity by a following of cult-like believers originating from the outskirts of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. According to its adherents, the Shrub, which essentially amounted to a type of [[Bush/Legends|bush]], was "generous and giving to all." True believers, who were also referred to as fellow pilgrims or spiritual travelers, maintained that the Shrub would "rain down its leaves to the willing." By the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], knowledge of the Shrub had spread to other parts of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. In one embarrassing incident, a member of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] fell in with the religious cult, and embarked on an unsanctioned spiritual vision quest. Hoping to put a stop to a stop to this, the Imperial-turned-cultist was tracked down and brought back to their superior to face punitive action.

==History==
{{Quote|I've got an embarrassing problem. One of my subordinates has fallen in with some kind of cult from the Tatooine outskirts. I want you to fetch this true believer back to me, so I can make it plain that I don't approve of ''spiritual vision quests'' on the Imperial clock. Understood? Good.|An Imperial superior, requesting that their subordinate be returned to face disciplinary action|<ref name="AED" />}}
In the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] named [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] saw the birth of a bizarre religious cult centered around a [[Plant/Legends|plant-like]] [[Bush/Legends|bush]] referred to as "the Shrub." Originating in the outskirts of the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] world, followers of the Shrub, who were identified as true believers, pilgrims, or spiritual travelers, maintained that the Shrub was a generous and giving entity. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="AED" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> knowledge of the Shrub had spread to other parts of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. This posed something of an embarrassing nuisance to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on at least one occasion.<ref name="AED" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}
When an Imperial subordinate abandoned their post to embark on an unsanctioned spiritual vision quest dedicated to the Shrub, their superior [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|paid]] a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to locate the individual and bring them back to face disciplinary action. The Imperial spiritual traveler was duly located and returned to their superior [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]], but not without first professing their faith in the Shrub and its supposed powers, including their cryptic belief that the Shrub would "rain down its leaves to the willing." The superior [[Officer/Legends|officer]] made a mockery of this, threatening that they would see what "rained down" once [[Sector Command (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Sector Command]] heard of their act of insubordination.<ref name="AED" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:FloatingShrub.jpg|200px|thumb|A shrub, like the one observed during beta, except rooted to the ground]]
The Shrub was first mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Early in the game's lifespan, dynamically spawned non-player characters offered a variety of simple [[W:c:swg:Quest|missions]], some of which were provided by NPCs of a specific [[W:c:swg:Faction|faction]]. In this case, [[W:c:swg:Galactic Empire|Imperial]] mission NPCs could offer an escort mission titled ''Retrieve a Spiritual Traveller'' with three varying levels of difficultly. The mission required the player to locate an NPC who had abandoned the Empire to embark on a spiritual journey centered around the Shrub, and escort them safely back to their assigned [[W:c:swg:Waypoint|waypoint]] in exchange for a [[W:c:swg:Imperial Credit|credit]] reward.<ref name="AED" />

The storyline of the aforementioned mission<ref name="AED" /> was evidently a reference to a real-world situation which transpired during the beta testing of [[W:c:swg:Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies'']]. During the testing of the game, players encountered a shrub on [[W:c:swg:Tatooine|Tatooine]] which floated above the ground due to a bug. This floating shrub spurred something of a jocular, cult-like following among at least some beta testers. Recognizing this, the game's developers created two test [[W:c:swg:Guild|guilds]], one of which was called Servants of the Shrub, and another opposing sect called the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force Sensitive]] [[Sheep/Legends|Sheep]].<ref name="WhoKnowsShrub">{{WebCite|url=http://swgemu.com/archive/scrapbookv51/data/20070206034315/index.html|text=Who knows about the Floating Shrub? :: ''Star Wars Galaxies'' Forums|work=SOE|archivedate=20160909041913}}</ref> By the time the game was fully released, the "floating shrub" issue had been resolved.<ref name="AED" /><ref name="WhoSeenShrub">{{WebCite|url=http://swgemu.com/archive/scrapbookv51/data/20070206034352/index.html|text=Has anyone seen The Holy Floating Shrub? :: ''Star Wars Galaxies'' Forums|work=SOE|archivedate=20160909103020}}</ref> Nevertheless, the situation inspired the creation of a Player Association on the [[W:c:swg:Bria|Bria]] [[W:c:swg:Server|server]] named Servants of the Shrub.<ref name="WhoKnowsShrub" /> The guild went on to write an online text titled the "Holy Book of the Shrub,"<ref name="HolyBook">{{WebCite|url=http://swgemu.com/archive/scrapbookv51/data/20070206034713/index.html|text=Holy Book of the Shrub|archivedate=20160909103658}}</ref> which further served as a source of amusement to players who recalled the legendary beta test bug.<ref name="BookShrub">{{WebCite|url=http://swgemu.com/archive/scrapbookv51/data/20070206034818/index.html|text=Holy Book&hellip;of the Shrub ??? :: ''Star Wars Galaxies'' Forums|work=SOE|archivedate=20160909065903}}</ref>
